title: Could the Ryan's gig have continued, and deciding to stay
summary: Waters guesses they could have returned to Ryan's, but he decided to stay after Archey's move because he had a job with Bill Coleman.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Right. If Archey hadn't joined Hines' band at that time, would you have been able to go back to Ryan's? Would the band have been able to go back, was the gig waiting for you back home with Archey or did you leave that behind -
Well, I don't know, see. That was, Archey knew more about that than I did, see, 'cause Archey was the leader of the band. I wasn't, see -
I imagine we could have went back because we were a very big success there.
Um hum. But had you decided even before Archey said this that you weren't gonna come back?
You decided after Archey said there was -
Yeah, I decided after Archey said. And then I wouldn't have stayed no way if it wasn't for I had a job with Bill Coleman.
